def equation(t, A, params):
    p=params
    g = p[0] + p[1]*np.exp(-t) + p[2]*t
    h = p[3] + p[4]*np.exp(-t) + p[5]*t
    k = p[6] + p[7]*np.exp(-t) + p[8]*t
    return g + h*A + k*A**2 + p[9]/(t*A)
